links.comparator_used: uncalibrated predictions and established baseline calibration methods, including isotonic regression and Platt scaling
links.outcome: predictive performance across six phenotypes, including F1-score, AUC, and Brier score decomposition
links.effect: Cohen's d = 0.603-5.002; F1-score gains ranging from +4.2% for fibromyalgia to +34.9% for dementia; AUC gains ranging from +4.7% to +40.1%; reliability reductions ranging from 11% to 29% and resolution increases ranging from +35% to +238%; isotonic regression AUC values degraded to 0.51-0.56 across all phenotypes
links.tradeoff: Requires supervised parameter development once per phenotype, followed by label-free deployment to target populations.
links.quote: SFI-aware calibration significantly improved predictive performance against both uncalibrated predictions and all baseline methods across nearly all six phenotypes (Cohen's d = 0.603-5.002, [Formula: see text]).

design_hint: label-free recalibration for distributional shift before deployment
